summary: This clinical trial is testing a dietary supplement called TRPTI to see how it affects GLP-1, a hormone related to appetite and metabolism, in adults who are overweight or obese. The study is sponsored by RDC Clinical Pty Ltd and currently has a status of Not yet recruiting. Researchers plan to enroll 20 participants for this Phase 4 trial. During the study, participants will compare the TRPTI supplement to a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks the same.
